# Femmeera

> Femmeera is an e-commerce fashion brand offering a curated collection of women's clothing, specializing in traditional Indian ethnic wear and contemporary western apparel.

## Brand Information
- **Official Website**: https://femmeera.com
- **Brand Focus**: Women's Traditional & Western Apparel
- **Primary Market**: India (Express Delivery & Cash on Delivery Available)

## Main Product Categories
- **Traditional Wear**: Sarees, Kurtis, Lehengas, Anarkali Suits, Ethnic Sets
- **Western Wear**: Western Dresses, Co-ord Sets, Tops, Partywear

## Important Brand & Customer Service Pages
- **About Us**: https://femmeera.com/about

- **Style Journal & Guides**: https://femmeera.com/journal
- **Privacy Policy**: https://femmeera.com/privacy
- **Terms & Conditions**: https://femmeera.com/terms
